definitions.meaning: To go forth, proceed, go by, pass, depart, die

quotations.old_english: Swá swá brýdguma forþgewítende of brýdbúre his
quotations.latin: tanquam sponsus procedens de thálamo suo
prætéritum tempus is the past tense
quotations.english: præstéritum tempus is the past tense

quotations.old_english: Se forþgewitena tíma the past tense

source_text: forþ-gewítan; p. -gewát, pl. -gewiton; pp. -gewiten To go forth, proceed, go by, pass, depart, die; proc&e-long;d&e-short;re, trans&i-long;re, præt&e-short;r&i-long;re, dec&e-long;d&e-short;re, m&o-short;ri :-- Swá swá brýdguma forþgewítende of brýdbúre his tanquam sponsus procedens de th&a-short;l&a-short;mo suo, Ps. Spl. 18, 5. Óþ-ðæt forþgewíteþ unriht d&o-long;nec transeat in&i-long;qu&i-short;tas, 56, 2. Swylce gysternlíc dæg ðe forþgewát tanquam dies hesterna quæ præt&e-short;riit, Ps. Lamb. 89, 4: Bd. 4, 9; S. 577, 35. Forþgewít and ríce proc&e-long;de et regna, Ps. Spl. 44, 5. Præt&e-short;r&i-short;tum tempus is forþgewiten tíd præst&e-short;r&i-short;tum tempus is the past tense, Ælfc. Gr. 20; Som. 23, 7, 10, 12, 13. Se forþgewitena tíma the past tense, Som. 23, 14. Ðone forþgewitenan tíman, Som. 23, 9.
